_comment: Operational settings. Edit here, commit, deploy. No code changes needed.

tax._note: Basis points. 600 = 6.00%. Product-level `taxable` is the default; a customer marked tax_exempt overrides it to zero.

shipping._note: P2. When enabled, checkout offers a ship-to address and validates against allowed_states server-side.

terms._note: Bump version whenever the text below changes. Every sale stores the version the customer accepted — this is dispute evidence.
terms.text: Orders are consolidated into a bulk order with our suppliers. Expect 2-4 weeks before your order is ready for pickup. We will email you when your order is placed and again when it is ready.

limits._note: Orders above this are held for review regardless of customer trust level.

pricing._note: products.json prices are the POSTED price and already absorb card processing cost. ACH and cash take 2% off. This is a cash-discount program, NOT a credit-card surcharge - see DESIGN.md. Never enable surcharging in Stripe.

cash_on_pickup._note: Cash orders carry no payment guarantee. On a 2-4 week pre-order we buy stock before seeing money, so restrict to known customers.
